name: code_parallel_verification_outcome
description: Deterministic code_parallel decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

candidateCommit.description: Commit SHA to report when the test cycle did not produce its own commit.

delivery.description: Delivery summary (e.g. code_parallel_delivery_summary output); only its 'state' field is inspected.

issues.description: Plan validation issues, passed through unchanged; coerced to [] when not an array.

mergeState.description: Merge verdict; must equal 'merged' for the outcome to pass.

planValid.description: Whether the plan was accepted; must be exactly true for the outcome to pass.

tested.description: Commit SHA produced by the test cycle, if any; used as candidateCommit when non-blank.

testState.description: Test cycle state; defaults to 'not_run' when not a string.

testsPassed.description: Whether the test cycle passed; only literal true counts as passed.

passed.description: True only when planValid is true, mergeState is 'merged', and delivery.state is 'passed'.

testsPassed.description: True only when the testsPassed input is literal true.

testCycleState.description: Passed-through testState input, or 'not_run' when absent/non-string.

candidateCommit.description: tested when it is a non-blank string, else candidateCommit.

state.description: Verdict folding plan validity, the merge, and the delivery outcome.

executionOutcome.description: Same value as 'state', exposed under this alias for downstream tasks.

mergeState.description: Passed through unchanged from the mergeState input.

planValid.description: True only when the planValid input is literal true.

delivery.description: Passed through unchanged from the delivery input.

issues.description: Passed-through issues input, coerced to [] when not a list.
